candidate: Full-cohort polynomial-state and cubic-dose Ridge standardization, using the existing nuisance model class and averaging in each fixed pre-offer group. Existing DR support checks for each population are shared. Do not clip or enforce monotonicity.
comparison: Incumbent local-linear continuous DR versus pooled outcome regression. Select alpha on development only by average paired overall and subgroup RMSE ratios. Compare analytic derivatives and upward target crossings on the same range. Retain all unsupported results.
adoption: At least 5% lower mean paired curve RMSE, at least 5% lower mean paired subgroup-difference RMSE, no coverage loss, no worse mean paired derivative RMSE, no worse false-reach or missed-reach counts, and improvement in overall curve RMSE in at least 4 of 6 confirmation seed blocks. Apply all gates jointly.
truth: Finite supplied distribution of observed baseline states, integrating the simulated unobserved outcome-only user state. Raw physical tasks round duration to the ten-second grid. Do not reopen old confirmation outcomes.
physical: Fresh 10-second 30-minute simulation using the established generator, 3 kW provided reference, single or split action (if at least 40 s and enough inactive bins), and decaying recovery. Compare the current extractor and CPOP on identical raw input. Process descriptors are optional for continuity/recovery. Native cohort is a chain replay, not the confirmation basis for the statistical candidate.
field_scope: ACN real records verify visible behavior. Continuous offer response and thresholds are evaluated on simulation; field estimates require matched prior offers, allocation and outcomes. Different outcomes retain their own units and denominators.
